versions.changelog: Add required_tools (manim, ffmpeg with libx264+libass, python3), required_packages, and network_access metadata to SKILL.md frontmatter. Addresses OpenClaw finding about missing binary declarations.

- No user-facing changes; documentation and skill description remain the same.
- Version bump to 1.0.2 with no file changes detected.

Security fix: remove shell=True command injection risk in run_pipeline.py and check_environment.py. Use subprocess argument lists instead of shell strings, add input validation for scene_name and file paths, replace os.system with subprocess.run.

Manim Animation 1.0.0 – Easily create math animations with synchronized TTS voiceover and subtitles

- Initial release with one-click pipeline for Manim animation, TTS narration (gTTS/pyttsx3), and automatic subtitle generation.
- Supports both on-screen subtitles in Manim code or SRT burning via ffmpeg, with detailed guidance to avoid double subtitles.
- Includes robust environment check script for all dependencies: Manim, manim-voiceover, gTTS, FFmpeg (libx264/libass), and fonts.
- Documentation covers quickstart, workflow, code patterns for narration/subtitles sync, troubleshooting (esp. libx264 issues), and Manim animation tips.
- Voiceover supports free (gTTS) and paid (Azure/OpenAI/ElevenLabs) TTS backends, configurable per project.
- All processing is local (no paid API required by default).
